summary: Sable Offshore Corp. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered follow-on offering of 32,467,533 shares of common stock at $3.08 per share, raising approximately $100 million. The underwriters, led by J.P. Morgan, have a 30-day over-allotment option for up to 4,870,129 additional shares. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; the filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other special events. Net proceeds of about $95 million before expenses will be used for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a standard secondary offering with no risk-arb angle; watch for completion on July 2, 2026.
